name: theme-solid-glass
title: Theme: Solid Glass
description: Solid Glass (deeplethe/solid-glass, MIT) as one more theme: panes of thick smoky glass — a rim of light on each top edge, a hairline round it, a shadow underneath — installed into themes/solid-glass/ (theme.json, semantics.json, light.tokens.json, dark.tokens.json, index.ts) for `selectTheme` to switch to while the app runs.
